description: This Java class, 'ProvisioningValuesLoader', loads default values necessary for NFC provisioning in an Android app. It reads configuration from a file on external storage, gathers device admin extras, and populates system values like device admin package, locale, timezone, and WiFi SSID.

classes.name: ProvisioningValuesLoader
classes.description: A loader that fetches default NFC provisioning configuration from disk, device settings, and resources.

methods.name: loadInBackground
methods.description: Loads provisioning values from disk, extras, and system settings.

methods.name: deliverResult
methods.description: Delivers the loaded provisioning values once ready.

methods.name: onStartLoading
methods.description: Starts the loading process, delivering cached results if available.

methods.name: onStopLoading
methods.description: Cancels the ongoing load if necessary.

methods.name: onReset
methods.description: Resets loader state and clears cached data.

methods.name: loadFromDisk
methods.description: Reads configuration data from external storage if available.

methods.name: loadFromFile
methods.description: Parses configuration key-value pairs from a file.

methods.name: gatherAdminExtras
methods.description: Creates a bundle of admin extras from the configuration values.

methods.name: loadSystemValues
methods.description: Fetches device-specific values such as locale, timezone, WiFi SSID, and device admin package.

methods.name: trimSsid
methods.description: Removes surrounding quotes from WiFi SSID strings.

methods.name: putIfMissing
methods.description: Helper to insert a value into the map if the key does not already exist.
